block.projecthero.synthezoid_cradle.tip: A vibranium body waits inside. Right-click it holding the Mind Stone to wake up as Vision.
message.projecthero.vision.title: Vision
message.projecthero.vision.subtitle: The Mind Stone wakes the synthezoid
message.projecthero.vision.acquired: You are Vision. The Mind Stone shines on your brow.
message.projecthero.vision.acquired_hint: Double-tap Space to fly. V projects a hologram of your own face and body, Shift+V makes you intangible. Hold Left-Alt for your moves.
message.projecthero.vision.already: The Mind Stone already shines on your brow.
message.projecthero.vision.cradle_hint: The body in the Cradle is empty. It needs the Mind Stone.
message.projecthero.vision.in_wall: You can't turn solid inside a wall
message.projecthero.vision.phase_out: The Mind Stone fades. You turn solid again.
message.projecthero.vision.density_out: Out of energy: your density returns to normal
message.projecthero.vision.phased: You're intangible: you can't touch anything
hud.projecthero.vision.title: Vision
projecthero.vision.ability.flight.desc: Double-tap Space in the air to take off or land. 20 blocks a second, 36 sprinting. Free: it's your own density control. Not while in Diamond Density.
projecthero.vision.ability.mind_beam.des: Hold: a golden beam from the Mind Stone on your brow, 32 blocks. 7 damage every quarter second and a small push. Up to 8 s. 6 energy to start, then 12 a second; 1.5 s cooldown.
projecthero.vision.ability.solar_lance.d: Gold gathers on your brow for a moment, then a piercing bolt shoots down your look: 20 damage to every creature on a 48-block line. 30 energy, 6 s cooldown.
projecthero.vision.ability.density_punch: A max-density fist, 5 blocks: 18 damage and a launch. A creature knocked into a wall takes 6 more. 10 energy, 1.5 s cooldown.
Your hand phases into the creature in front of you (5 blocks) and turns solid: 14 damage that ignores armour, and it's stunned for 2 s. 15 energy, 4 s cooldown.
projecthero.vision.ability.mind_pulse.de: A golden burst around you, 7 blocks: 12 damage, a hard shove outward, and everything hit glows for 5 s. 25 energy, 8 s cooldown.
projecthero.vision.ability.unleashed.des: Your ultimate. You hover in place and pour out the Mind Stone for 3 s: a huge golden beam (48 blocks) that hits everything along it for 7 every 4 ticks (up to 105). Look around to sweep it. 80 energy, 2 min cooldown.
projecthero.vision.ability.phase_dash.de: Dash 10 blocks along your look in a quarter second, intangible the whole way: you pass through creatures and nothing hurts you. 8 energy, 1 s cooldown.
Look at a creature (24 blocks): you phase straight through it and turn solid inside it for 22 damage, a launch and a 1 s stun, ending behind it. No target and 4+ blocks of air below: a meteor drop for 14 damage +0.6 per block fallen (up to +16) in 4.5 blocks. Neither: a short rush that hits the first creature for 22. 25 energy, 5 s cooldown.
projecthero.vision.ability.grip.desc: Grab a creature (6 blocks, up to 120 health) and hold it in front of you for up to 4 s. Press again to throw it: it takes 10 when it hits a wall, the ground or another creature (that one too). 12 energy, 3 s cooldown.
projecthero.vision.ability.diamond_densi: Toggle. Turn as dense as diamond: another 50% off every hit (65% in all), no knockback, +6 melee damage, but 35% slower and you can't fly. 3 energy a second.
projecthero.vision.ability.hologram.desc: Toggle. The Mind Stone projects a hologram of your own skin over you, built from your head down. While it's up you look like yourself: no suit, no cape. All your powers still work. Free, 1.5 s cooldown.
projecthero.vision.ability.intangibility: Toggle. Attacks and projectiles pass straight through you and nothing can hurt you, but you can't attack either. Walk through walls (not floors or ceilings). You can't switch it off inside a wall. 10 energy to start, then 8 a second.
projecthero.guide.vision.body: The synthezoid Ultron built for the Mind Stone. Vision flies, fires the Mind Stone's golden beam and controls his own density: heavy as diamond, or a ghost that walls and arrows pass through. He can even wear your own face again with a hologram.
projecthero.guide.vision.getting_text: Purge Ultron. Your first clear gives you the Mind Stone, and every clear drops Vibranium Plating and an Ultron Core. Craft the Synthezoid Cradle (3 Glass on top, Vibranium Plating, Ultron Core, Vibranium Plating in the middle, 3 Iron Blocks below) and place it. Right-click it holding the Mind Stone: the stone sets into the body, lightning strikes, and you wake up as Vision. The stone is used up. It replaces your Primary power. Random serums never give it.
projecthero.guide.vision.body_text: 45 health, 30% off every hit and +6 melee damage. You never get hungry (your food bar stays near full, so you repair slowly), never drown, and take no fall damage. Poison and wither don't affect you, and you can't suffocate in a wall.
projecthero.guide.vision.energy_text: The gold Meter pays for your moves. It refills 2.5 a second, 4 a second in direct sunlight and 1.5 in the dark (caves, the Nether, the End). It doesn't refill while your beam, Intangibility or Diamond Density is draining it.
projecthero.guide.vision.hologram_text: Press V and the Mind Stone draws your own skin over you, line by line from your head down, with a gold scan line. Once it's whole you just look like yourself: no Vision suit, no cape. Your powers all still work. Press V again and it fades away from your feet up.
projecthero.guide.vision.phasing_text: Shift+V makes you intangible: no hit, arrow or fireball can touch you and you walk through walls, but you can't attack (only Phase Dash and your toggles work). You can't turn solid inside a wall. If your energy runs out inside one, you're pushed out to the nearest open space. Shift+C does the opposite: Diamond Density makes you so heavy that hits barely hurt and nothing knocks you back, but you're slow and can't fly.
projecthero.guide.vision.commands.body: Operators: /projecthero power grant vision <player>, /projecthero power tune vision energy <0-100>, /projecthero power tune vision cooldowns.
